name: email-rfc5322
description: A comprehensive RFC 5321/5322 email address validator. Validates local-part (before @), domain, and sub-domain syntax including quoted strings, IP address literals, international domain names (IDN), and checks for length constraints and prohibited characters.
aiPromptContext: Use this block to validate email addresses in forms and APIs. More standards-compliant than simple regex solutions, supporting all valid RFC 5322 email edge cases like quoted local parts.
